messages:
sam: Handoff — quick watchlist before I sign off. I updated the board with a couple noisy signals that kept popping during my shift. TL;DR: prefetch jitter in eu-cache, encoder-pool CPU spikes on 3 pods, small KV cache evict spike on node-17. I'll be offline at 02:15 UTC. Please escalate to eng-sre if latency > 10% over baseline.

marta: thanks — can you paste the alert queries and which dashboards? I'll keep coverage. :+1:

sam: Sure. Dashboards: Observability > Prefetch > EU Cache / Encoder Pools. Alerts to watch:
- 'prefetch_jitter_rate' (rule: rate(prefetch.latency[5m]) > 0.07)
- 'encoder_pod_cpu_spike' (rule: increase by 2x in 1m)
- 'kv_evictions_node17' (>50 evictions/5m)

Snippet of the prefetch query I use:
```
sum(rate(prefetch.latency_seconds_bucket{region="eu"}[5m])) by (le)
```
Also note noisy alert pattern: most spikes correlate with small batch job runs from analytics; correlate with tag 'job=analytics-prefetch'.

oncall-bot: deployment redwood-inference/eu-prefetch-service rolled out to 4 nodes at 01:48 UTC (sha: a1b2c3). :white_check_mark:

lee: I added a temporary alert suppression for 'prefetch_jitter_rate' for 10m windows if origin=analytics-job to reduce noise. If we still get noise after the rollout, I'll widen the window. FYI I also created query to show which request paths spike.

ara: FYI I scheduled a rolling drain of node-17 at 04:30 UTC to clear stale KV handles. Will annotate in infra-calendar.

marta: ack. I'll watch SLOs and the encoder pool heatmap. If cpu_spike alerts trigger, I'll run: `kubectl top pods -l app=encoder -n inference` and collect pprof. If encoder pods keep flapping, set scale target to +2 replicas temporarily.

sam: Leaving these follow-ups:
- @lee: if suppression still noisy after 15m, drop it and we'll investigate logs
- @ara: confirm node-17 drain completed and post result
- @marta: if prefetch latency > 250ms p50 or error% > 2% escalate to oncall-sre

marta: noted. small FYI — I saw one error trace referencing `kv.Get` timeout ~120ms at 01:05, might be transient. I'll add a snippet to the evaluation runbook.

sam: thanks. I'm off. ping me if anything blocks rollout. :wave:

lee: thanks, have a good one. keeping an eye.

ara: drain done — node-17 cordoned and drained at 04:37 UTC, no pod evictions failed. Logs show stale locks cleared. :white_check_mark:

marta: encoder pool is stable after scale +1 at 02:05 — p95 down from 1.2s to 650ms. closing watch for encoder unless it recurs.

oncall-bot: Incident thresholds crossed? No. All SLOs within target. (checked at 05:00 UTC)

marta: will mark this as 'watch' on the handoff doc and add a short post-shift note. Good handoff, thanks @sam.
